source: Barbulescu et al., J Immunol (2025), vkaf201. Supplementary Figure S2A (per-mouse J_H4 tables) and S2C (G:C Ts/Tv P values), transcribed 2026-10-16 from the supplementary figures PDF.
matrix_orientation: rows = To (A, T, C, G), columns = From (A, T, C, G), as printed; diagonal is null. This reading is the one the data support: the wild-type spectrum it gives correlates with the nanopore reads of the same mice at r = 0.89 and with SHMtrace's reading of the same chromatograms at r = 0.97, against 0.46 and 0.61 for the transposed reading.
note: f_mut is the published mutation frequency per base. Printed cells sum to the printed totals in all six tables. The paper's Supplementary Figure S2C (G:C transitions and transversions, Wt vs Mkln1-/-) matches these tables only when they are read transposed (Ts 28 vs 17%, as the bars show); read as printed they give Ts 23.5 vs 27.9% (p = 0.24) and Tv 15.7 vs 27.3% (p = 0.004), which SHMtrace reproduces. The paper reports 3 Wt and 3 Mkln1-/- mice; the per-mouse folders of the original project hold 3 Wt and 3 Mkln1-/- folders, and the 2024 collection folder holds further KO-labelled clones (MKLN_KO_2/3/4, JH4K1) that are not filed under a mouse.
figure3_checks: Checked 2026-10-16 against the published article's Figure 3 (no source data are published). Fig. 3A and 3D print 109 wild-type and 218 Mkln1-/- sequences; the per-mouse tables here sum to 110 and 227. Fig. 3D's pooled wild-type frequency (6.83e-3) uses 109 sequences of 556 bp and its knockout frequency (9.27e-4) uses 227, while the same panel prints 218. Fig. 3B's P = 0.0179 is not given by a standard test on the per-mouse frequencies here (two-tailed t 0.027, one-tailed 0.014, Welch 0.075); the earlier manuscript printed 0.0181. Fig. 3C's P = 0.0131 and 0.307 equal the earlier manuscript's to four digits and are reproduced by neither orientation of these tables. Fig. 3E's Mkln1 Ts:Tv P = 0.1 comes out at 0.07-0.09; its Maea and Fam72a comparisons reproduce from those papers' source data. The text's '~13-fold' matches neither these tables (7.8-fold) nor Fig. 3D (7.4-fold). Comparisons in the CRM paper use these per-mouse tables only.
